flags.why: This expression is mainly Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label; [quạu is documented as Southern](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/qu%E1%BA%A1u).
This word belongs mainly to formal or literary usage, which the untagged entry fails to indicate ([dictionary reference](https://vdict.com/qu%E1%BA%A9n%20b%C3%A1ch%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
The example explains what people called chữ Nôm instead of using quốc ngữ to mean that script.
flags.fix: Ông đọc được những bài thơ quốc ngữ viết bằng chữ Nôm. = He could read the poems written in chữ Nôm.
